paragraphs: United Airlines Holdings, Inc. (together with its consolidated subsidiaries, "UAL" or the "Company") is a holding company and its wholly-owned subsidiary is United Airlines, Inc. (together with its consolidated subsidiaries, "United"). United's shared purpose is "Connecting People. Uniting the World." United has the most comprehensive route network among North American carriers, including U.S. mainland hubs in Chicago, Denver, Houston, Los Angeles, New York/Newark, San Francisco and Washington, D.C.

As UAL consolidates United for financial statement purposes, disclosures that relate to activities of United also apply to UAL, unless otherwise noted. United's operating revenues and operating expenses comprise nearly 100% of UAL's revenues and operating expenses. In addition, United comprises approximately the entire balance of UAL's assets, liabilities and operating cash flows. When appropriate, UAL and United are named specifically for their individual contractual obligations and related disclosures and any significant differences between the operations and results of UAL and United are separately disclosed and explained. We sometimes use the words "we," "our," "us," and the "Company" in this report for disclosures that relate to all of UAL and United.

The Company's principal executive office is located at 233 South Wacker Drive, Chicago, Illinois 60606 (telephone number (872) 825-4000). The Company's website is located at www.united.com and its investor relations website is located at ir.united.com. The information contained on or connected to the Company's websites is not incorporated by reference into this Form 10-K and should not be considered part of this or any other report filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC"). The Company's filings with the SEC, including annual reports on Form 10-K, quarterly reports on Form 10-Q, current reports on Form 8-K, and all amendments to those reports, as well as UAL's proxy statement for its annual meeting of stockholders, are accessible without charge on the Company's investor relations website, as soon as reasonably practicable, after we electronically file such material with, or furnish such material to, the SEC pursuant to Section 13(a) or 15(d) of the Exchange Act. Such filings are also available on the SEC's website at www.sec.gov.

The Company transports people and cargo throughout North America and to destinations in Asia, Europe, Africa, the Pacific, the Middle East and Latin America. UAL, through United and its regional carriers, operates across six continents, with hubs at Chicago O'Hare International Airport ("ORD"), Denver International Airport ("DEN"), George Bush Intercontinental Airport ("IAH"), Los Angeles International Airport ("LAX"), Newark Liberty International Airport ("EWR"), San Francisco International Airport ("SFO"), Washington Dulles International Airport ("IAD") and A.B. Won Pat International Airport ("GUM").

All of the Company's domestic hubs are located in large business and population centers, contributing to a large amount of "origin and destination" traffic. The hub and spoke system allows us to transport passengers between a large number of destinations with substantially more frequent service than if each route were served directly. The hub system also allows us to add service to a new destination from a large number of cities using only one or a limited number of aircraft. As discussed under Alliances below, United is a member of Star Alliance, the world's largest alliance network.

United Next. In 2025 the Company continued to make progress with its United Next plan to align its network and product with the potential of its hubs while remaining focused on protecting the safety of its employees and customers and providing a superior customer experience. United Next aims to increase customer choice and win brand-loyal customers by offering a diversity of products ranging from Basic Economy to Polaris and growing our leading global network, which the Company believes will lead to diverse revenue streams for the Company. As part of its United Next growth plan, the Company expects to

take delivery of over 630 new narrow- and widebody aircraft by the end of 2034. The new aircraft that the Company has taken delivery of to date have increased the Company's gauge, scale and connectivity as well as improved the Company's fuel efficiency. Other key highlights of its United Next plan include:
•increasing our employee headcount by more than 38,000 employees since 2020;
•surpassing 530 new and retrofit aircraft featuring United's signature interior with bigger bins, seatback screens at every seat and Bluetooth connectivity;
•expanding the Company's leading global network to destinations like Bangkok, Thailand; Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam; and Adelaide, Australia.
•inaugurating service to eight new destinations: Nuuk, Greenland; Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia; Faro, Portugal; Puerto Escondido, Mexico; Palermo, Italy; Bilbao, Spain; and Madeira Island, Portugal.
•launching Kinective MediaSM – the first media network that uses insights from travel behaviors to connect customers to personalized advertising, experiences and offers from leading brands;
•bringing Starlink's Wi-Fi service (the world's fastest, most reliable Wi-Fi in the sky) to our United Express regional aircraft and beginning installation on our mainline aircraft; and
•making significant technology changes that empower the Company's employees and improve the customer experience.

headings: Strategic and Business Development Risks
We may not be successful in executing elements of our strategic operating plan, which may have a material adverse impact on our business, financial results and market capitalization.
Business, Operational and Industry Risks

The global airline industry is highly competitive and susceptible to price discounting and changes in capacity, which could have a material adverse effect on our business, operating results and financial condition.
Our MileagePlus loyalty program plays a significant role in our business, and unfavorable developments affecting the program could adversely affect our business and results of operations.
Unfavorable economic and political conditions, in the United States and globally, may have a material adverse effect on our business, operating results and financial condition.

Geopolitical conflict, terrorist attacks or security events may adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.
Managing our reputation and brand image is critical to our business success and if our reputation or brand image is damaged, it could adversely affect our business or financial results.
Disruptions to our regional network and United Express flights provided by third-party regional carriers could adversely affect our business, operating results and financial condition.
Information Technology, Cybersecurity and Data Privacy Risks
Increasing privacy, data security and cybersecurity obligations or a significant data breach may adversely affect the Company's business.
Increased use of social media platforms present risks and challenges.
Human Capital Management Risks
If we are unable to recruit, hire, develop or retain skilled personnel, including our senior management team or other key employees, our business could be adversely affected.
Regulatory, Tax, Litigation and Legal Compliance Risks
The airline industry is subject to extensive government regulation, which imposes significant costs and may adversely impact our business, operating results and financial condition.
paragraphs: Any of the risks and uncertainties described below could significantly and negatively affect our business operations, financial condition, operating results (including components of our financial results), cash flows, prospects, reputation or credit ratings, which could cause the trading price of our common stock to decline significantly. Additional risks and uncertainties that are not presently known to us, or risks that we currently consider immaterial, could also impair our business operations, financial condition, operating results, cash flows, prospects, reputation or credit ratings.

United Next, the Company's strategic operating plan, includes firm orders of over 630 narrow- and widebody aircraft, retrofitting plans and plans to continue to increase mainline daily departures and available seats across the Company's North American network. In developing our United Next plan, we made certain assumptions including, but not limited to, customer demand (in light of changing economic conditions), fuel costs, delivery of aircraft, aircraft certification approval timelines, labor market constraints and related costs, supply chain constraints, inflationary pressures, voluntary or mandatory groundings of aircraft, our regional network, competition, market consolidation and other macroeconomic and geopolitical factors. We also subsequently adjusted certain of our assumptions as a result of the increase in costs due to infrastructure improvements, new labor contracts and aircraft maintenance that were needed to support our United Next plan as well as delays in aircraft deliveries. Actual conditions may be different from our assumptions at any time and could cause us to further adjust our strategic operating plan. In addition, we cannot provide any assurance that we will be able to successfully execute our strategic plan, that the growth we anticipate will occur through execution of our strategic plan will not exacerbate any other risk described in this Form 10-K (especially relating to fuel costs, the impact of economic pressures or geopolitical events, our supply chain or our ability to recruit, hire, develop and retain talent), that our strategic plan will not result in additional unanticipated costs, that our suppliers will timely provide adequate products or support for our products (including but not limited to certification and delivery of aircraft, engines and other aircraft parts) or that our strategic plan will result in improvements in future financial performance. If we do not successfully execute our United Next or other strategic plans, if actual results vary significantly from our expectations or if we otherwise fail to successfully structure our business to meet market conditions, our business, operating results, financial condition and market capitalization could be materially and adversely impacted.

Changes in the Company's network strategy over time or other factors outside of the Company's control may make aircraft on order less economical for the Company, result in costs related to modification or termination of aircraft orders or cause the Company to enter into orders for new aircraft on less favorable terms, and any inability to accept or integrate new aircraft into the Company's fleet as planned could increase costs or affect the Company's flight schedules.

The Company's orders for new aircraft are typically made years in advance of actual delivery of such aircraft and the financial commitment required for purchases of new aircraft is substantial. As a result of our network strategy changing or our demand expectations not being realized, our preference for the aircraft that we previously ordered may decrease; however, we may be responsible for material liabilities to our counterparties if we attempt to modify or terminate any of our existing aircraft order commitments and as a result our financial condition could be adversely impacted. These risks are heightened as a result of the Company's sizeable United Next aircraft orders. Additionally, the Company may have a need for additional aircraft that are not available under its existing firm orders or options and may seek to acquire aircraft from other sources, such as through lease arrangements, which may result in higher costs and/or less favorable terms, or through the purchase or lease of used aircraft. The Company may not be able to acquire such aircraft when needed on favorable terms or at all.

Furthermore, if, for any reason, the Company is unable or does not want to accept deliveries of new aircraft or integrate such new aircraft into its fleet as planned, the Company may face higher financing and operating costs than planned or litigation risks, and may be required to seek extensions of the terms for certain leased aircraft or otherwise delay the exit of other aircraft from its fleet. Unanticipated extensions or delays may require the Company to operate existing aircraft beyond the point at which it is economically optimal to retire them, resulting in increased maintenance costs, or potentially requiring the Company to reduce its schedule, thereby reducing revenues.

The imposition of new tariffs, any increase in existing tariffs, and retaliatory tariffs implemented by other countries where United operates, on the importation of commercial aircraft, engines or commercial aircraft parts that the Company orders may result in higher costs. In addition, to the extent our key aircraft, engine or aircraft parts suppliers are affected by tariffs and seek to pass those costs onto us, our costs of acquiring new aircraft, engine or aircraft parts could increase.

paragraphs: 聯合航空控股公司（United Airlines Holdings, Inc.）（連同其合併子公司，簡稱"UAL"或"本公司"）為一家控股公司，其 wholly-owned subsidiary 為聯合航空公司（United Airlines, Inc.）（連同其合併子公司，簡稱"United"）。United 的共同目標為 "Connecting People. Uniting the World." United 擁有北美電信業者中最完整的航線網路，包括美國本土的中轉站於芝加哥、丹佛、休士頓、洛杉磯、紐約/紐瓦克、舊金山及華盛頓特區。

由於 UAL 為財務報表目的合併 United，因此與 United 活動相關的揭露亦適用於 UAL，除非另有說明。United 的營運收入與營運費用約佔 UAL 收入與營運費用的 100%。此外，United 約佔 UAL 資產、負債與營運現金流的全部。當適當時，UAL 與 United 會根據其個別契約義務及相關揭露明確說明，並說明 UAL 與 United 運作與結果之間任何重大差異。我們在本報告中偶爾會使用 "we"、"our"、"us" 及 "Company" 來指涉與 UAL 與 United 有關的所有揭露。

本公司主要營業據點位於 233 South Wacker Drive, Chicago, Illinois 60606 (電話號碼 (872) 825-4000)。本公司網站位於 www.united.com，其投資人關係網站位於 ir.united.com。本公司網站或連結至本公司網站之資訊，並未納入本 Form 10-K 之參考，亦不應視為本或任何其他向美國證券交易委員會 ("SEC") 提報之報告之內容。本公司向 SEC 提報之資料，包括年度報告 (Form 10-K)、季報 (Form 10-Q)、現況報告 (Form 8-K) 以及所有對這些報告之修正資料，以及 UAL 之年度股東大會委任書，將在本公司投資人關係網站上免費提供，於本公司依證券交易法第 13(a) 或 15(d) 章節向 SEC 電子提報或提供資料後，盡速提供。這些資料亦可在 SEC 網站 www.sec.gov 取得。

本公司運輸旅客與貨物遍及北美地區，以及亞洲、歐洲、非洲、太平洋、中東與拉丁美洲等地點。透過 United 及其區域電信業者，UAL 運營遍及六大洲，中轉站包括芝加哥奧黑爾國際機場（"ORD"）、丹佛國際機場（"DEN"）、喬治·布殊國際機場（"IAH"）、洛杉磯國際機場（"LAX"）、紐瓦克自由國際機場（"EWR"）、舊金山國際機場（"SFO"）、華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場（"IAD"）及 A.B. 韋恩·帕特國際機場（"GUM"）。
本公司所有國內中轉站均位於大型商業與人口中心，促進大量 "起點與終點" 旅客流量。中轉站與輻射式系統使我們能以遠較直接航線更頻繁的服務運輸旅客至大量目的地。中轉站系統亦使我們能以少量或有限數量的飛機，從大量城市新增至新目的地的服務。如後述聯盟部分所述，United 為 Star Alliance 會員，為全球最大的聯盟網路。

United Next。在 2025 年，本公司持續根據其 United Next 計畫，使其航線網路與產品與其中轉站潛力對齊，同時專注於保護員工與旅客的安全，並提供優越的旅客體驗。United Next 計畫旨在增加旅客選擇，吸引品牌忠誠旅客，透過提供從 Basic Economy 到 Polaris 的多樣化產品，並擴大本公司領先的全球網路，本公司認為這將為本公司帶來多樣化的收入來源。根據其 United Next 成長計畫，本公司預期
於 2034 年底前接收超過 630 架窄體與寬體飛機。本公司迄今已接收的飛機已提升本公司之航線覆蓋、規模與連通性，並改善本公司之燃油效率。其 United Next 計畫的其他重點包括：
• 自 2020 年以來，員工人數增加超過 38,000 人；
•超越 530 新增及翻新飛機，搭載聯合航空獨特的客艙內裝，包含更大的行李架、每座位背螢幕以及藍牙連接功能;
•擴展本公司的領先全球航線網路至如泰國曼谷、越南胡志明市以及澳洲阿德雷德等目的地;
•啟航至八個新目的地：格陵蘭島努克、蒙古烏蘭巴託、葡萄牙法羅、墨西哥普埃布拉埃斯condido、義大利巴勒莫、西班牙畢爾包以及葡萄牙馬德拉島;
•啟動 Kinective MediaSM – 首個結合旅行行為洞察的媒體網路，用以連結旅客與來自領導品牌的個性化廣告、體驗與優惠;
•將 Starlink 的 Wi-Fi 服務（全球最快的、最可靠的空中 Wi-Fi）引入本公司的 United Express 區域型飛機，並開始在主線飛機上進行安裝; 和
•進行重大科技變更，以強化本公司員工的作業效能並提升旅客體驗。

paragraphs: United Airlines Holdings, Inc.（含其合併子公司，簡稱「UAL」或「本公司」）為一間控股公司，其全資子公司為United Airlines, Inc.（含其合併子公司，簡稱「United」）。

因UAL為財務報表目的合併United，與United相關之揭露亦適用於UAL，除非另有說明。United之營運收入與營運費用約佔UAL之收入與營運費用的99%。此外，United約佔UAL資產、負債及營運現金流的全部。當適當時，UAL與United會針對其個別契約義務及相關揭露特別說明，並針對UAL與United營運及結果之間任何重大差異進行分別揭露與說明。我們在本報告中偶爾會使用「我們」、「我們的」、「我們」及「本公司」等詞彙，用以說明與UAL與United相關之揭露。
我們以下所描述的當前預期為展望性陳述，我們實際結果與時間點可能因多種因素而有重大差異，包括但不限於下文「策略」、「經濟與市場因素」、「政府措施」、「展望性陳述警示聲明」及本Form 10-K第一部分第1A項「風險因素」所討論之內容。本報告所呈現之結果未必反映未來營運結果。
我們共同的宗旨為「連接人們。團結世界。」我們擁有北美電信業者中最完整的航線網路，包括美國本土的芝加哥、丹佛、休士頓、洛杉磯、紐約/紐瓦克、舊金山及華盛頓特區等主要樞紐。
我們是全球最大的航空公司，以可銷售座位英里數為衡量標準，協助約1.81億名乘客連接至六大洲超過380個目的地。本公司持續專注於四大策略支柱，其認為這些策略已幫助並將持續幫助United與產業其他公司區隔開來：

•United Next：我們在2025年持續推動United Next計畫，以使我們的航線與產品與樞紐潛力對齊，同時專注於保護員工與乘客的安全，並提供優越的乘客體驗。United Next旨在透過提供從Basic Economy到Polaris的多樣化產品，增加乘客選擇並爭取品牌忠誠客戶，同時擴大我們領先的全球航線網路，本公司預期這將為本公司帶來多樣化的收入來源。根據我們的United Next成長計畫，我們預期至2034年底將接收超過630架窄體與寬體飛機。本公司迄今已接收的飛機已提升我們的航線規模、連接性，並改善本公司之燃油效率。我們United Next計畫的其他重點包括：
–自2020年起，員工人數增加超過38,000名；
–超越530架新機與翻新機，搭載我們標誌性的客艙，包含更大的行李空間、每座位背屏及藍牙連線功能；
擴展我們領先的全球網路至如Nuuk, Greenland; Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia; Faro, Portugal; Puerto Escondido, Mexico; Palermo, Italy; Bilbao, Spain; 以及Madeira Island, Portugal等目的地;
啟動Kinective MediaSM（第一個結合旅行行為洞察，將客戶與領導品牌個性化廣告、體驗及優惠連結的媒體網路）;
將Starlink的Wi-Fi服務（全球最快的、最可靠的空中Wi-Fi）引入我們的United Express區域飛機，並開始在主線飛機上進行安裝；以及
進行重大科技變更，賦予員工更多權限並提升客戶體驗。

headings: 戰略與業務發展風險
我們可能無法成功執行我們戰略運營計畫的某些要素，這可能會對我們的業務、財務結果及市場資本額造成重大不利影響。
業務、運營與產業風險
全球航空業競爭激烈，且易受價格折扣及運力變動影響，這可能會對我們的業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
我們的 MileagePlus 忠誠計畫在業務中扮演重要角色，若該計畫出現不利發展，可能會對我們的業務及營運結果造成不利影響。
美國及全球不景氣與政治條件不佳，可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成重大不利影響。
提供服務予本公司，可能會對本公司的業務、營運結果及財務狀況造成重大不利影響。
地緣政治衝突、恐怖攻擊或安全事件可能會對我們的業務、財務狀況及營運結果造成不利影響。
經營本公司聲譽與品牌形象對業務成功至關重要，若本公司聲譽或品牌形象受損，可能對業務或財務結果產生不利影響。
區域網路與由第三方區域電信業者提供的聯合快運航班若發生中斷，可能對業務、營運結果與財務狀況產生不利影響。
資訊科技、網路安全與資料隱私權風險
資訊隱私權、資料安全與網路安全義務持續增加，或發生重大資料外洩事件，可能對本公司業務產生不利影響。
社交媒體平台使用率增加，可能帶來風險與挑戰。
人力資源管理風險
若本公司無法招募、僱用、培訓或留任具專業技能的人員，包括高階管理團隊或其他關鍵員工，業務可能受到不利影響。
法規、稅務、訴訟與法律合規風險

paragraphs: 任何在下文所述的風險與不確定性，都可能顯著且負面地影響本公司的營運、財務狀況、營運結果（包括財務結果的組成部分）、現金流、前景、聲譽或信用評等，這可能會導致本公司普通股的交易價格顯著下跌。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前尚未為本公司所知，或本公司目前認為不重要，這些風險也可能影響本公司的營運、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流、前景、聲譽或信用評等。

United Next，為本公司戰略營運計畫，包含超過630架窄體與寬體飛機的訂單、翻新計畫，以及持續增加本公司北美網路每日航班與可用座位數的計畫。在制定我們的United Next計畫時，我們做出了一些假設，包括但不限於客戶需求（考慮到經濟條件的變化）、燃油成本、飛機交付、飛機認證批准時間表、勞動市場限制與相關成本、供應鏈限制、通貨膨脹壓力、飛機自願或強制停飛、區域網路、競爭、市場集中與其他總體經濟與地緣政治因素。我們也因基礎建設改善、新勞動契約與飛機維護所需成本增加，而調整了部分假設。實際情況可能與我們的假設不同，並可能導致我們進一步調整戰略營運計畫。此外，我們無法提供任何保證，我們將能成功執行戰略計畫，預期的成長不會因執行戰略計畫而加劇任何其他風險（特別是與燃油成本、經濟壓力或地緣政治事件的影響、供應鏈或我們招募、聘僱、培訓與留住人才的能力相關），戰略計畫不會導致額外的未預期成本，我們的供應商會及時提供足夠的產品或支持我們的產品（包括但不限於飛機、引擎及其他飛機零件的認證與交付），或戰略計畫會導致未來財務表現的改善。如果我們未能成功執行United Next或其他戰略計畫，如果實際結果與我們的預期有顯著差異，或我們未能成功調整業務結構以適應市場條件，則我們的業務、營運結果、財務狀況與市場資本額可能受到重大且不利的影響。
本公司網路策略的變化或其他超出本公司控制範疇的因素，可能使已訂購的飛機對本公司而言變得不經濟，導致與修改或終止飛機訂單相關的成本，或使本公司不得不以較不利的條件訂購新飛機，任何無法按計畫接受或整合新飛機至本公司機隊的情況，都可能增加成本或影響本公司飛行排程。

本公司訂購新飛機的訂單通常是在實際交付前數年就做出的，而購買新飛機所需的財務承諾相當重大。因此，若本公司網路策略發生變化或需求預期未實現，本公司對之前訂購飛機的偏好可能下降；然而，若本公司試圖修改或終止任何現有飛機訂單，可能需承擔重大對應方的財務責任，因此財務狀況可能受到不利影響。這些風險因本公司規模龐大的United Next飛機訂單而更加嚴重。此外，本公司可能需要額外的飛機，而這些飛機並未包含在現有確定訂單或選擇權中，因此可能尋求從其他來源取得飛機，例如透過租賃安排，這可能導致更高的成本與/或較不利的條件，或透過購買或租賃二手飛機。本公司可能無法在需要時以有利條件或任何條件取得這些飛機。
此外，若因任何原因，本公司無法或不願接受新飛機的交付或按計畫將其整合至機隊，本公司可能面臨高於預期的融資與營運成本，或法律訴訟風險，並可能需要延長某些租賃飛機的租賃期限，或延遲其他飛機從機隊中退出。未預期的延長或延遲可能導致本公司必須繼續運作現有飛機，直到經濟上不再合適退休為止，這將導致維護成本增加，或可能需要本公司減少飛行排程，從而減少收入。
新關稅的實施、現有關稅的增加，以及其他國家對本公司訂購的商用飛機、引擎或商用飛機零件進口所實施的報復性關稅，可能會導致成本增加。此外，若我們的關鍵飛機、引擎或飛機零件供應商受到關稅影響，並試圖將這些成本轉嫁給我們，我們取得新飛機、引擎或飛機零件的成本可能會增加。
